acceptance: An upstream Theseus issue or change exists for retrying idempotent GitHub reads on 5xx in the prepare step, and is linked here.
BenchBox pins a Theseus version in which a single 503 on the pull-request read does not fail the review job, or the owner records a decision not to change it.
The recovery command for a review that died before any reviewer ran is stated in `docs/agent/merge-authority.md` next to the sentence that tells agents to re-run a review when a reviewer errors.
description:
On 2026-11-12 the `verdict / review` job for PR #4170 (run 43239267451) failed after 10 seconds in the step 'Prepare the review': `theseus_reviewer.github.GitHubError: gh api repos/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pulls/4170 failed: gh: HTTP 503`. No reviewer ran, no verdict was posted, the `verdict posting check` and `review-gate` then failed, and the pull request stayed blocked until the review was dispatched again by hand with `gh workflow run review-verdict.yml --ref develop -f pr=4170 -f head=<sha>`. The failing code is in the pinned Theseus reviewer package, not in this repository.

Decision gate: establish first whether the reviewer already retries that read and the 503 outlasted it, or does not retry. The fix belongs upstream in Theseus; this item tracks the report and the pin that picks it up. Also decide whether a prepare-step failure should count against the daily rerun budget.
